prompt: [Character] Image 1 [Signature] In the lower right corner, there is a small Threads logo, and above it, "CHAse" is written in small white cursive like a signature. [Pose and Expression] Pose and Composition: A centered medium shot capturing a cheerful moment of holding a blue vinyl LP cover with both hands over the head. Pose: Holding both arms in a triangle shape with the LP cover held slightly upside down, tilting the upper body pleasantly to the left. The free-spirited upper body line and sculptural beauty of the arms create an indie artist's vibe. Expression: Not looking directly at the camera lens but glancing to the upper right with a curious and playful look. The slightly parted lips and transparent mask evoke a witty aura characteristic of Y2K indie pop. [Outfit and Props] Outfit: Top: A deep blue sleeveless ribbed crop top with a three-dimensional texture. Bottom: A minimal linen/denim texture long skirt in light sky blue with natural shirring at the waist, completing a sophisticated tone-on-tone blue look. Props: LP Cover (CHASE - Love Wins All): A bright cyan blue LP paper cover held above the head as a retro rock visual point. Nails: Neatly groomed pure white nail art providing a clear contrast with the blue tones. [Hair and Makeup] Hair: Rich jet black long natural straight hair falling over shoulders and back. Makeup: Clear porcelain skin under direct flash lighting with subtle brown shadow and moist pinkish coral glossy lips. [Lighting] Source: Direct studio camera flash from the front. Effect: Creates deep drop shadows on the background wall following the silhouette, producing a 90s vintage magazine contrast. [Texture and Color Mood] Colors: Deep blue, sky blue, and cyan blue creating a 'Cool Retro Indie Pop' mood. Texture Details: Matte and hard paper texture of the LP sleeve, ribbed fabric of the top, and glossy skin with sharp shadow edges. [Camera] Composition: Horizontal eye-level shot. Features: Deep depth of field and sharp focus ensuring model features and LP typography are crystal clear. [Background] Space: Minimalist light cool gray/ivory studio horizon wall focusing entirely on the subject.

promptZh: [角色] 图像 1 [签名] 右下角有一个小的 Threads 标志，上方用白色小字草书写着“CHAse”作为签名。[姿势与表情] 姿势与构图：居中的中景镜头，捕捉双手将蓝色黑胶唱片封面举过头顶的欢快瞬间。姿势：双臂呈三角形，将唱片封面略微倒置，上半身愉快地向左倾斜。自由奔放的上半身线条和手臂的雕塑美感营造出独立艺术家的氛围。表情：没有直视镜头，而是带着好奇和俏皮的神情看向右上角。微张的双唇和透明的面罩唤起 Y2K 独立流行音乐特有的机智光环。[服装与道具] 服装：上衣：深蓝色无袖罗纹短款上衣，具有立体质感。下装：浅天蓝色极简亚麻/牛仔质感长裙，腰部有自然的褶皱，完成了精致的同色系蓝色造型。道具：黑胶唱片封面 (CHASE - Love Wins All)：明亮的青蓝色黑胶纸质封面，举在头顶作为复古摇滚的视觉焦点。指甲：修剪整齐的纯白色美甲，与蓝色调形成鲜明对比。[发型与妆容] 发型：浓密乌黑的长直发自然垂落在肩部和背部。妆容：在直射闪光灯下呈现清透的瓷肌，搭配淡淡的棕色眼影和湿润的粉珊瑚色亮面唇妆。[灯光] 光源：来自正面的影棚直射闪光灯。效果：在背景墙上产生跟随轮廓的深邃投影，营造出 90 年代复古杂志的对比感。[质感与色彩氛围] 色彩：深蓝、天蓝和青蓝色，营造出“酷炫复古独立流行”的氛围。质感细节：黑胶封套的哑光硬纸质感、上衣的罗纹面料，以及带有锐利阴影边缘的亮面肌肤。[相机] 构图：水平视平线镜头。特征：深景深和清晰的对焦，确保模特面部特征和黑胶唱片上的排版清晰可见。[背景] 空间：极简的冷灰色/象牙色影棚地平线墙，将焦点完全集中在主体上。
